name: ecommerce-build
title: E-commerce Build (add-on)
description: E-commerce page scaffolding layered on top of website-build: a Feature per shop page (PLP, PDP and the checkout steps), each with Design / Front-end / Back-end / QA / QC tasks. Pair with stripe-integration for the payment provider work.

variables.name: build_list
variables.description: Task list (project phase) for the build

tasks.title: Product Listing Page (PLP)
tasks.description: Product Listing Page (PLP) delivery, from design through to QC.

subtasks.title: Design: Product Listing Page
subtasks.description: Category/listing design for desktop and mobile: product cards, filtering, sorting, pagination and empty states.

subtasks.title: Front-end / CMS: Product Listing Page
subtasks.description: Build the PLP template: product cards, filtering, sorting, pagination, wired to the commerce catalogue. Responsive across breakpoints.

subtasks.title: Back-end: Product Listing Page
subtasks.description: Category/catalogue queries, filtering and sorting logic, pagination, caching.

subtasks.title: QA: Product Listing Page
subtasks.description: Internal testing: filters and sorting return correct results, pagination works, empty states handled, responsive, cross-browser.

subtasks.title: QC: Product Listing Page
subtasks.description: Final quality control on UAT with the real catalogue: imagery, pricing and stock display correct.

tasks.title: Product Details Page (PDP)
tasks.description: Product Details Page (PDP) delivery, from design through to QC.

subtasks.title: Design: Product Details Page
subtasks.description: Product page design for desktop and mobile: gallery, pricing, variants, add-to-basket, stock states, related products.

subtasks.title: Front-end / CMS: Product Details Page
subtasks.description: Build the PDP template: gallery, variant selection, pricing, add-to-basket, stock messaging, related products. Responsive across breakpoints.

subtasks.title: Back-end: Product Details Page
subtasks.description: Product/variant models, pricing and stock lookups, add-to-basket behaviour, structured data (Product schema).

subtasks.title: QA: Product Details Page
subtasks.description: Internal testing: variants switch price/imagery/stock correctly, add-to-basket works for every variant state, out-of-stock handled, responsive, cross-browser.

subtasks.title: QC: Product Details Page
subtasks.description: Final quality control on UAT with real products: content, pricing and imagery correct; structured data validates.

tasks.title: Checkout - Basket
tasks.description: Checkout - Basket delivery, from design through to QC.

subtasks.title: Design: Basket
subtasks.description: Basket design for desktop and mobile: line items, quantity changes, removal, discount codes, totals, empty basket state.

subtasks.title: Front-end / CMS: Basket
subtasks.description: Build the basket: line items, quantity update/remove, discount code entry, totals (including VAT and shipping estimate), proceed to checkout. Responsive.

subtasks.title: Back-end: Basket
subtasks.description: Basket state management, price/total recalculation, discount code validation.

subtasks.title: QA: Basket
subtasks.description: Internal testing: quantities update totals correctly, removal works, discount codes apply and reject properly, basket persists as expected.

subtasks.title: QC: Basket
subtasks.description: Final quality control on UAT: totals, VAT and discount behaviour verified against real pricing.

tasks.title: Checkout - Shipping Details
tasks.description: Checkout - Shipping Details delivery, from design through to QC.

subtasks.title: Design: Shipping Details
subtasks.description: Shipping step design for desktop and mobile: address entry, shipping method selection with prices, validation states.

subtasks.title: Front-end / CMS: Shipping Details
subtasks.description: Build the shipping step: address form with validation, shipping method selection updating the total. Responsive.

subtasks.title: Back-end: Shipping Details
subtasks.description: Address validation, shipping method/price calculation per country, persistence into the order.

subtasks.title: QA: Shipping Details
subtasks.description: Internal testing: validation messages helpful, every shipping method prices correctly, country changes update available methods.

subtasks.title: QC: Shipping Details
subtasks.description: Final quality control on UAT: shipping methods and prices match the agreed rate card for every destination offered.

tasks.title: Checkout - Billing Details
tasks.description: Checkout - Billing Details delivery, from design through to QC.

subtasks.title: Design: Billing Details
subtasks.description: Billing/payment step design for desktop and mobile: billing address (same-as-shipping option), payment form, error states.

subtasks.title: Front-end / CMS: Billing Details
subtasks.description: Build the billing step: billing address with same-as-shipping toggle, payment provider integration (see the stripe-integration template), clear error handling for declined payments. Responsive.

subtasks.title: Back-end: Billing Details
subtasks.description: Payment intent creation and confirmation via the payment provider, order creation on success, failure handling without phantom orders.

subtasks.title: QA: Billing Details
subtasks.description: Internal testing with test cards: success, decline and 3DS flows all behave; failed payments leave no phantom order; validation is helpful.

subtasks.title: QC: Billing Details
subtasks.description: Final quality control on UAT: full checkout run-through, payment reaches the provider sandbox and the order records correctly.

tasks.title: Checkout - Order Complete Page
tasks.description: Checkout - Order Complete Page delivery, from design through to QC.

subtasks.title: Design: Order Complete Page
subtasks.description: Order confirmation design for desktop and mobile: order summary, number, delivery expectations, next steps.

subtasks.title: Front-end / CMS: Order Complete Page
subtasks.description: Build the confirmation page: order summary and number, purchase tracking dataLayer event for GA4. Responsive.

subtasks.title: Back-end: Order Complete Page
subtasks.description: Order retrieval for confirmation display, confirmation email trigger, analytics purchase event data.

subtasks.title: QA: Order Complete Page
subtasks.description: Internal testing: correct order shown after checkout (and not accessible for someone else's order), confirmation email sends, GA4 purchase event fires with correct value.

subtasks.title: QC: Order Complete Page
subtasks.description: Final quality control on UAT: end-to-end order with the confirmation email reviewed for content and formatting.
